description: Header file implementing the Observer pattern for state change notifications within the ANGLE project, defining interfaces, classes, and enums related to observers and subjects.

classes.name: ObserverInterface
classes.description: Interface for observer objects to receive state change notifications.

classes.name: ObserverBindingBase
classes.description: Base class for binding an observer to a subject with a specific index.

classes.name: Subject
classes.description: Maintains a list of observer bindings and notifies them of state changes.

classes.name: ObserverBinding
classes.description: Binds a specific observer to a subject with a designated index, managing state change notifications.

methods.name: IsInContainer
methods.description: Checks if an element exists within a container.

methods.name: onSubjectStateChange
methods.description: Method called when a subject's state changes, to notify observers.

methods.name: hasObservers
methods.description: Returns true if the subject has registered observers.

methods.name: addObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer binding to the subject.

methods.name: removeObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer binding from the subject.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Associates a subject with an observer binding.

methods.name: onStateChange
methods.description: Handles a state change message and notifies the bound observer.
